g.text: starts a run, asks how it goes
the four routes and the run desk
the player, the runner, the judge
in the same program, asked over HTTP
the agent's model and the judge's
every answer of a live run
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The eval library a site's API program maps:
a run asks the agent over the sessions API like any app, keeps its file in the data folder, and
its recordings are the engine's, in the replay folder.
